items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Johnny Hodges sessions and Paul Gonsalves sessions

ctx.x: And that was the first time you got to play with Duke Ellington.

That’s right, first and last. First and last time I actually, he’s playing the piano, I’m playing the guitar. I was on sessions with him where he brought in some music and was just there for Johnny Hodges sessions and Paul Gonsalves sessions, but I never actually played with him.
What was it like meeting him for the first time? I don’t think we talked about that.
